records.title: Kutta discovery: does smooth trailing-edge departure emerge?

modelComponents.integrator: drift → pair collisions → walls → bodies, velocity-Verlet kicks when forces present /1
modelComponents.openBoundaries: reservoir-boundary/1 (kinetic flux, optional velocity profile; A-18)

records.geometry: 180 × 100 domain, open reservoirs on all sides; polygon body, chord 30, thickness 2.5, leading edge at x = 50
records.wallModel: polygon body with Maxwell accommodation Aw = 1 (A-19); reservoir boundaries (A-18)

reynolds.note: No measured μ supplied (set `viscosity` from a Couette record).

emptySpace.note: Master prompt §20: occupancy and density extremes on cells of ~40 particles; a cell below 0.1 φ_mean in 5 consecutive samples flags POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE. Low density near open boundaries (A-18) is expected and is not near-zero occupancy.

cases.label: sharp TE (rhombus), α = 8°
cases.determination: SMOOTH DEPARTURE WITH LIFT: the gas leaves along the trailing-edge bisector while the body carries significant lift

startingVortex.note: Sign opposite to the early body circulation. Peak of the seed-mean slab circulation in the start-up period; significant if > 3 SD of the late-window slab series.

shedding.criterion: Fisher g test p < 0.01 on the late lift series

wake.note: ρu(U_e − u) integrated across the domain; pressure and stress terms are neglected, so this is a diagnostic, not a balance
ρu(U_e − u) integrated across the domain; pressure and stress terms are neglected, so this is a diagnostic, not a balance
ρu(U_e − u) integrated across the domain; pressure and stress terms are neglected, so this is a diagnostic, not a balance

results.conventions: Flow along +x. Lift = +y force on the body, drag = +x force. Circulation counter-clockwise positive (a body lifting upward in +x flow has negative Γ in this convention). Angles in degrees; departure angle measured from the trailing-edge bisector, positive toward the upper side.

uncertainty.note: Seed ensembles (independent realisations of the same impulsive start); time series are seed means at equal times.

convergence.note: Single resolution, domain and particle scale (Step 15 addresses scaling).

benchmarks.note: Displayed only after the measurement (Master prompt §19). Thin-airfoil theory with the Kutta condition imposed, inviscid, incompressible, unbounded: Γ = −π U c sin α, L = ρ U |Γ| per unit span. Not used by the run or the determination.

acceptance.description: No run halted by the safety monitor
No particle centre ever inside the body
Energy ledger incl. body and open-boundary fluxes closes
Momentum ledger incl. body impulse and open-boundary fluxes closes

acceptance.criterion: no POTENTIAL MODEL / NUMERICAL FAILURE flag

acceptance.description: sharp TE (rhombus), α = 8°: late-window lift is stationary (second half vs first half)
